Torque Rating~150 N·m

A six-bolt rigid flange coupling built for a 25 mm shaft, rated to roughly 150 N·m of transmitted torque. Modelled every component individually — flange, spacer, hex bolts, nuts — then mated into a full assembly, with a complete drawing sheet covering front view, sectioned assembly, and bill of materials.

A 3:1 spur gear pair sized for a 500 W transmission running at 1000 RPM input speed (~4.8 N·m input torque). Tooth dimensions and stress levels were validated analytically against AGMA guidelines before the drawing sheet was finalised.

A pillow-block bearing housing for a 25 mm shaft, built around a 6205 deep-groove ball bearing. Produced four manufacturing-ready drawing sheets — shaft, bearing block, individual components, and full assembly — using H7/g6 fit tolerancing to guarantee a correct bearing-to-shaft interface.
